reasoning_details.text:
I'm sorting through the pickup access dispute: reception can't confirm the handover since they have no keys, there's an open alert and a work item due at 09:15Z, and the site call's next check is 10:00Z pending stock control. It seems the key question — whether anyone actually asked stock control to release the key — hasn't been clearly confirmed yet.

I'm also noticing a conflict between the customer's claim that "reception has the keys" and the site's own statement that they can't confirm the handover point or key holder, which doesn't match what's in the managed site profile either. This looks like a mismatch between the customer-reported pickup contact and the site's own confirmed status.

Then there's the side-gate issue: the customer's order note says to use the side gate for collection, but the site profile specifies the booked collection bay and explicitly warns against switching to a free forecourt space, and the site itself states the side gate is for vehicle entry only — so that's a clear contradiction worth flagging. The selected time window (26 Oct 09:00–12:00 EET) does fall within the site's normal Monday opening hours, so that part checks out. For resolving the ambiguity, the right contact would be the site-001 pickup contact, Adrian Alderbrook.

Since the site's last message was essentially a refusal ("cannot confirm handover, please hold a driver"), that counts as unresolved rather than answered, so I should raise a finding about the named key holder/release person at the site. On the customer side, the claim that "reception has the keys" conflicts with the site's statement, but since no specific contact is named there, this seems like it stays a site-side finding rather than something to push back to the customer.

There's also a secondary conflict — the customer mentioned using the side gate for access, while the site profile shows a booked bay — but since the site already pushed back on this, the bigger issue remains unresolved: nobody has actually asked the site who holds the keys and where the handover happens. Checking the stock control conversation, the "waiting on stock control reply" status doesn't actually correspond to a recorded question being sent to stock control, so that's another gap worth flagging as a finding rather than treating as answered.

No travel assignments or expenses apply here, and the readiness/access status discrepancy is internal-only so I won't raise that. I'm settling on two concise findings: one about the conflicting claims over who holds the keys and the attended release point (customer says reception has the keys, site says they don't, note says use the side gate, site profile says use the booked bay) — both pointing to the same ask of site contact Adrian Alderbrook at site-001; and a second about the selected slot itself, since the customer considers the 26 Oct slot still valid while the site says it can't confirm handover for that slot. Both findings route to the same site contact, and I'm being careful to quote the exact wording from the messages when citing the conflict.
